$comment:
Signal format catalog — real production channel messages pinned as parse expectations.
Purpose: keep the pipeline tested across the VARIETY of real channels instead of a
handful of hand-written formats, and give the test tool a source of diverse messages.
Consumers:
  1. worker/src/signalCatalog.test.ts — runs on every `npm test` (regression gate).
  2. scripts/test-signal.mjs `catalog list|send` — browse categories, live-send an entry
     case instead of inventing yet another BUY XAUUSD message.
  3. AI few-shot prompts — cases with "fewshot" in useFor are eligible training
    eligible training examples for the stage-2/stage-3 prompts (cases whose
    note says KNOWN ISSUE are excluded from fewshot and liveSend on purpose).
Notes:
  * expect.* is pinned from the LOCAL deterministic parser at build time; when
    production recorded something else a "prodNote" records the difference.
  * "note" flags known issues kept deliberately — do not treat them as desired.
  * Messages are verbatim production text from customer channels (no credentials);
    the test chat channel is excluded. Sources: production signal ids in history.
